trigger_context: User asks to create or refactor Next.js App Router routes, layouts, loading/error UI, dynamic routes, metadata, SEO, server actions, or rendering strategy.
workflow_step_titles: Inspect route tree and rendering needs

required_inputs.recipe_step_id: Provided by the recipe orchestrator when invoked as part of a recipe.
required_inputs.problem_statement: Create nextjs-app-router-rendering-skill for Next.js App Router layouts route groups server components SSR ISR metadata SEO
required_inputs.success_definition: Agents follow Next.js App Router Rendering Skill with concrete React/Next.js examples, evidence checks, and no invented conventions.

optional_recipe_inputs.context_pack_refs: External context pack identifiers or file/service references supplied by the recipe.
optional_recipe_inputs.control_pack_refs: External control pack identifiers or file/service references supplied by the recipe.
optional_recipe_inputs.adapter_ref: Project or platform adapter reference supplied by the recipe when technology conventions are external.
optional_recipe_inputs.evidence_correlation_id: Correlation id used by an external evidence/audit service.

external_context_packs.use: Use supplied context packs for domain vocabulary, examples, business rules, and field semantics.

external_control_packs.use: Use supplied control packs for mandatory validation, policy checks, human gates, and evidence requirements.

control_tags: compliance:Maintain accessibility and security boundaries when applicable
escalation_hooks: Client components should be used only for interactivity; server data, secrets, and privileged calls stay server-side.
App routes need explicit loading, error, not-found, and empty states for realistic user flows.
Dynamic pages should generate metadata, canonical URLs, and sitemap behavior from validated route params.
Do not render time, random ids, browser APIs, or user-only data differently on server and client.

output_contract.skill_md: Generated instructions must remain under 500 lines.
output_contract.references: Explicit load conditions required for each reference.
output_contract.scripts: Preflight and integration adapters should be deterministic.
